consent.boundary: You are approving one exact feedback report — the one printed just above the question, ending in its fingerprint. Nothing is sent until you answer yes, and answering anything else sends nothing at all.
The same approval as the first time, asked again on the saved report: nothing is sent until you answer yes, and answering no leaves the draft exactly where it was.

package.outcome: Look at the system you have built, notice the thing that is wrong with it, and tell the people who make s0ma — with the whole report in front of you, and nothing leaving your machine until you say so.

recovery.action: The viewer is running and there is nothing built for it to draw. Build the project once and reload the page — the viewer repaints as builds land, so nothing needs restarting.

steps.expected_visible_state: A local address on your own machine, printed and then opened in a browser. The viewer reads what the build produced; it never runs your application.
steps.purpose: Put the built project on screen, so you are looking at what it is rather than at what you remember writing.

steps.expected_visible_state: The whole graph the build produced, wrapped in the reading number it belongs to — the same document the graph command prints, passed on entire rather than summarised, so the picture and the build cannot disagree.
steps.purpose: Let the page ask for the thing it draws: every part of the project, and the wiring between the parts.

steps.expected_visible_state: The report on screen field by field, in the words you wrote, ending in the fingerprint that ties it to what you approve; then two questions — whether kn0wthyself may contact you, and whether to send exactly this.
steps.purpose: Write up what the picture showed you in one line, and read back the report s0ma composed from it before deciding anything.

steps.expected_visible_state: Every report written on this machine and not yet sent, each with its short identifier and the line you wrote — or one sentence saying there are none, which is the answer when nothing was ever composed.
steps.purpose: Find the report again after answering no, or after a send that could not get through — it was saved before the question that sends anything.

steps.expected_visible_state: The saved report shown again in full, the contact answer you already gave repeated back to you, and the same send question — a second look at exactly what would travel.
steps.purpose: Read the saved report once more and finish sending it, or decide again not to.
